results.title: VDURA and Wasabi Unite High-Performance AI Storage with Cloud Economics
results.description: LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--(Ai4 2026) – VDURA and Wasabi Technologies, the hot cloud storage company, have announced a technology alliance to connect GPU-adjacent AI data infrastructure with predictably priced S3-compatible cloud storage. Through the alliance, the companies will collaborate to help AI factories, neoclouds and enterprise HPC environments place active datasets and checkpoints close to GPUs while extending long-term retention, protection and data reuse into the cloud.
